patterns: tell me about placements at sdit
what is the placement record of sdit
response: Shree Devi Institute of Technology has consistently maintained an excellent recruitment record. On average, 90-95% of eligible final year students have been placed through campus placements over recent years. Placements begin in the 7th semester with participation from top-tier corporate and engineering sector companies.

patterns: how many offer letters were given
what percentage of students get placed
response: On average 90–95% of eligible final year students are placed through campus placements. Historical offer letter statistics include: 427+ offers in 2016, 452+ in 2017, 461+ in 2018, 480+ in 2019, and 492+ offer letters in 2020.

list of recruiting companies at sdit
response: Leading companies recruiting from SDIT include Infosys, Accenture, Amazon, IBM, Cognizant, Deloitte, Oracle, EY, PwC, HCLTech, Cisco, Dell Technologies, Tech Mahindra, Wells Fargo, SLK Software, Mphasis, Trigent Software, Airtel, Ericsson, QSpider, ICICI Bank and many others.

patterns: does sdit give pre placement training
how does sdit prepare students for interviews
are there aptitude classes for placement
tell me about training and placement cell
response: The Department of Placement & Training provides pre-placement training on aptitude, logical skills, technical knowledge and communication for 2nd, 3rd and final year students. Activities include mock interviews by experts, placement talks by resource persons, resume building workshops, PDP programs, bridge courses and assistance with industrial internships.

patterns: who is the tpo at sdit
response: The Training and Placement Officer (TPO) at Shree Devi Institute of Technology is Mr. Roshal Lynshal Nazareth. The department facilitates campus recruitment, pool campus drives, and industry interaction for students.

response: The Placement and Training Department cell has set up dedicated facilities for conducting recruitment drives, including a seminar hall for company presentations, group discussion rooms, conferencing facilities, and interview & discussion rooms.
